Slugs are the ids used in claim.bears_on[].party and in relevance scores. `aliases` lists other name forms researchers used before canonicalization (2026-09-27 cleanup: johanan-alemanno merged into alemanno, elia-del-medigo/elijah-delmedigo merged into delmedigo, barbaro-correspondent merged into barbaro, all 0-2 uses at merge time; see DECISIONS.md). RESEARCHERS propose additions in their packet's `proposed_parties`; the orchestrator merges (`scripts/claims_merge_vocab.py`), checking for an existing alias before adding a new id.
